**Finding: compliant** (rule IP — Ownership of deliverables and Customer Data).

The document meets the **preferred** position on every material term:

- **Deliverables:** § 14.2 vests ownership in Customer on creation (subject to Fees) with an express Vendor assignment of worldwide right, title and interest, personnel assignments, and further assurances.
- **Customer Data / Customer IP:** § 14.1 confirms Customer ownership of Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information and independently developed IP, with only a limited processing right to Vendor. § 1.3 defines Customer Data broadly (including derived output); § 15.1 bars sale, advertising use, commingling and model training without consent.
- **Vendor pre-existing IP + licence back:** Vendor keeps only Vendor Technology (§ 1.9, which excludes Customer Data and pre-Effective Date Customer IP), and § 14.3 applies the § 13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, modify, create derivative works from and have contractors support embedded Vendor Technology.
- **No joint ownership:** § 14.4 negates it absent a signed instrument setting exploitation rights; feedback is limited to generalized, non-identifying suggestions with Customer retaining unrestricted rights.

No assignment of our IP or data runs to the Vendor, so no redline was proposed.
